verdicts.note: Self-IDs as 'the only girl'; female confirmed throughout (woman-in-engineering probes).
Currently on placement, started six/seven months ago; clearly yes.
'you need the experience to get a job... at least a year's experience' strongly endorses work experience.
'go and see the real world... cloud cuckoo land' supports valuing seeing what industry is really like.
'it will help me get a job, having such a big reputable company on your CV' directly supports job-chances.
'very relevant... actually seeing it working in real life' strongly affirms applying theory.
Confidence to talk to managers/operators is genuine personal development from placement.
'now I'm here... I think I'll probably end up going into environmental career' supports helping decide direction.
'take back to uni' is generic learning transfer; never mentions improving GRADES specifically. Quote does not support the grades construct.
Finds modules 'very related'/connected, so disagrees it is difficult to see module relevance. Direction (disagree) correct.
'at uni it teaches you to listen to everyone...' credits course with developing interpersonal skills.
'environmental advisor' does not map to listed engineering areas; 'other' defensible.
Quote is about not wanting to be a lone manager at a SMALL company when first leaving (size/readiness), not a managerial-vs-specialist role preference. Does not support technical/specialist.
'the only thing that puts me back is its location... middle of nowhere' makes location a clear deciding factor (important).
Says working abroad 'does' appeal but heavily hedged (language problem, 'I don't know'); appeal != decision-importance. Thin; retain low confidence.
